_meta.purpose: Institutional-grade building-block / signal / risk mapping consumed by TradesPanel strategy-notes tooltips (BTCAAAAA-39021).
_meta.registryRef: src/detectors/building_blocks/registry.py — dual-signal validation (signal + signal_simple), @register_block decorator, category priority (OSCILLATORS=1, TREND=2, INSTITUTIONAL=3, PRICE_ACTION=4, SMC_ICT=5, PATTERNS=6)

TP1.label: Take Profit 1 — primary scaled exit
TP1.thesis: TP1 closes 50% of the position at the first measured-move target (typically 1R or VWAP reversion for mean-reversion strategies), as governed by the universal TP allocation pattern (TP1=50%, TP2=30%, TP3=20%) and gated by MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 in RiskEnforcer so no single trade concentrates risk beyond the institutional floor.

TP2.label: Take Profit 2 — secondary scaled exit
TP2.thesis: TP2 closes 30% of the position at the second measured-move target (typically 2R or opposite Bollinger Band for mean reversion), aligning with the universal TP-allocation pattern (TP1=50%, TP2=30%, TP3=20%) and constrained by MIN_POSITION_SIZE=0.001 in RiskEnforcer so the residual remains executable.

TP3.label: Take Profit 3 — runner exit
TP3.thesis: TP3 closes the residual 20% at the third measured-move target (typically 3R–4R or 2× initial risk for mean reversion), completing the universal TP allocation (TP1=50%, TP2=30%, TP3=20%) and intentionally leaving the runner exposed to MAX_BARS or trailing-stop continuation so the position captures the institutional-grade trend phase without breaching DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500.

TP4.label: Take Profit 4 — extended runner (strategy-specific)
TP4.thesis: TP4 is an optional fourth scaled target reserved for strategies with confluence > 80 (e.g. strategy_11_williams_fractal) where 4R measured-move continuation is supported by multi-timeframe break-of-structure confirmation; the residual position remains capped by DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500 and trailing-stop L3 (2.0×ATR) so the runner cannot bleed the daily book.

TP5.label: Take Profit 5 — exhaustion runner (strategy-specific)
TP5.thesis: TP5 is reserved for high-conviction breakouts where 5R or higher is structurally defended by IB Breakout + Wave Consolidation + BOS confluence (strategy_06); the position is reduced to MIN_POSITION_SIZE=0.001 and governed by trailing-stop L3 (2.0×ATR) so the residual auto-liquidates before breaching DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500.

SL.label: Stop Loss — structural invalidation
SL.thesis: SL closes 100% of the position when price invalidates the entry thesis by breaching 1.5×ATR beyond entry (common pattern across all strategies) or the structural level behind the entry block (e.g. below BOS swing-low for LONG, above BOS swing-high for SHORT), and is auto-attached by RiskEnforcer.check_and_submit at entry ± 2% (STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02) as the institutional floor; DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500 caps the absolute USD exposure of all SL hits in a single session.

STOP_LOSS.label: Stop Loss — RiskEnforcer auto-attached floor (alias of SL)
STOP_LOSS.thesis: STOP_LOSS is the RiskEnforcer.check_and_submit auto-attached stop_market at entry ± 2% (STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02) that sits beneath every strategy-level structural SL so a fat-finger or extreme gap cannot breach MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 or DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500; it is the institutional last-resort floor, distinct from the strategy's structural SL.

MAX_BARS.label: Maximum Bars Held — time-based exit
MAX_BARS.thesis: MAX_BARS closes the position when barsHeld exceeds the strategy-specific threshold (e.g. 50–200 bars across the strategy corpus) without hitting any TP or SL, on the premise that a thesis that hasn't reached TP within the structural horizon is invalidated by time decay and must release capital for the next signal; the closure respects MIN_POSITION_SIZE=0.001 to avoid orphan lots and is bounded by DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500.

TIME_LIMIT.label: Time Limit — kill-zone window expiry
TIME_LIMIT.thesis: TIME_LIMIT closes the position at the kill-zone boundary (e.g. London close 16:00 UTC, NY close 17:00 UTC) when the thesis depends on session-specific liquidity and the session has ended, preventing the position from carrying into the next session's opposing liquidity regime; sized via MIN_POSITION_SIZE=0.001 cleanup and capped by DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500.

BULLISH_BREAKOUT.label: Bullish Breakout
BULLISH_BREAKOUT.thesis: Fired by Initial Balance Breakout (weight=30, category=PATTERNS) when price closes above the IB high with volume confirmation, gated by confluence ≥60 in strategy_06 so only multi-block-aligned breakouts reach execution, with RiskEnforcer.check_and_submit sizing the entry to MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and auto-attaching STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

BEARISH_BREAKOUT.label: Bearish Breakout
BEARISH_BREAKOUT.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_BREAKOUT — fired by Initial Balance Breakout (weight=30, PATTERNS) when price closes below the IB low with volume confirmation, with confluence ≥60 in strategy_06 gating execution and RiskEnforcer attaching the SHORT-leg stop at entry + 2% (STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02).

BULLISH_BOS.label: Bullish Break of Structure
BULLISH_BOS.thesis: Fired by Break of Structure (weight=20, SMC_ICT) when price closes above the most recent swing-high, confirming trend continuation; in strategy_06 the 22-point weight pairs with IB Breakout to form the high-conviction long setup, with RiskEnforcer.check_and_submit sizing to MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the broken swing-low.

BEARISH_BOS.label: Bearish Break of Structure
BEARISH_BOS.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_BOS — fired by Break of Structure (weight=20, SMC_ICT) when price closes below the most recent swing-low, with strategy_06 22-point weight pairing with IB Breakdown for high-conviction shorts and RiskEnforcer attaching the SHORT stop at entry + 2% (STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02) above the broken swing-high.

BULLISH_MEAN_REVERSION.label: Bullish Mean Reversion
BULLISH_MEAN_REVERSION.thesis: Fired by Bollinger Bands (weight=10) when RSI (weight=25, OSCILLATORS) prints below 30 (oversold) and Stochastic RSI (weight=18) prints a bullish cross, with EMA2050Trend (weight=15) confirming uptrend and VWAP (weight=15, INSTITUTIONAL) within tolerance — confluence ≥55 in strategy_15 sized to TP1=VWAP (50%), TP2=opposite BB (30%), TP3=2R (20%), SL=1.5×ATR, all gated by RiskEnforcer.

BEARISH_MEAN_REVERSION.label: Bearish Mean Reversion
BEARISH_MEAN_REVERSION.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_MEAN_REVERSION — fired by Bollinger Bands + RSI>70 (overbought) + Stochastic RSI bearish cross + EMA2050 downtrend + VWAP rejection, with strategy_15 confluence ≥55 and RiskEnforcer attaching the SHORT stop at entry + 2% above the entry candle high.

BULLISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE.label: Bullish RSI Divergence
BULLISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE.thesis: Fired by RSI Divergence (weight=25, OSCILLATORS — highest weight in the corpus) when price prints lower-low while RSI prints higher-low, signaling exhaustion of the bearish leg; in strategy_15 this is the primary reversal trigger, paired with Bollinger Bands lower-band touch and VWAP support, sized via RiskEnforcer with STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the most recent swing-low.

BEARISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE.label: Bearish RSI Divergence
BEARISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_RSI_DIVERGENCE — fired by RSI Divergence (weight=25) when price prints higher-high while RSI prints lower-high, signaling bullish exhaustion; in strategy_15 paired with Bollinger upper-band touch and VWAP rejection, with RiskEnforcer stop at entry + 2% above the swing-high.

BULLISH_MACD_CROSS.label: Bullish MACD Cross
BULLISH_MACD_CROSS.thesis: Fired by MACD Signal (weight=25, OSCILLATORS) when MACD line crosses above signal line with histogram strength ≥150 (BTC 15min moderate threshold), confirming momentum shift; in strategy_06 the 22-point MACD weight is one of three high-conviction confluence triggers (with BOS 22pts + IB Breakout), gated by RiskEnforcer with MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02.

BEARISH_MACD_CROSS.label: Bearish MACD Cross
BEARISH_MACD_CROSS.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_MACD_CROSS — fired when MACD crosses below signal with histogram magnitude ≥150; in strategy_06 pairs with IB Breakdown + Bearish BOS for high-conviction shorts, gated by RiskEnforcer with SHORT-leg stop at entry + 2%.

BULLISH_STOCHASTIC_RSI.label: Bullish Stochastic RSI Cross
BULLISH_STOCHASTIC_RSI.thesis: Fired by Stochastic RSI (weight=18, OSCILLATORS) when %K crosses above %D in oversold territory (<20), confirming mean-reversion entry; in strategy_15 this is the 18-point tertiary trigger after RSI Divergence (25pts) and Bollinger Bands (15pts), with RiskEnforcer sizing the entry and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

BEARISH_STOCHASTIC_RSI.label: Bearish Stochastic RSI Cross
BEARISH_STOCHASTIC_RSI.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_STOCHASTIC_RSI — fired when %K crosses below %D in overbought (>80), with strategy_15 18-point weight and RiskEnforcer stop at entry + 2%.

BULLISH_VWAP_RECLAIM.label: Bullish VWAP Reclaim
BULLISH_VWAP_RECLAIM.thesis: Fired by VWAP (weight=15, INSTITUTIONAL — priority 3) when price reclaims VWAP from below with a 15min close above, signaling institutional re-accumulation; in strategy_01_vwap_pullback this is the primary long trigger and in strategy_15 it provides confluence for mean-reversion longs, gated by RiskEnforcer with MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the VWAP re-test candle.

BEARISH_VWAP_REJECTION.label: Bearish VWAP Rejection
BEARISH_VWAP_REJECTION.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_VWAP_RECLAIM — fired when price rejects VWAP from above with a 15min close below, signaling institutional distribution; in strategy_01 paired with the LONG signal's inverse and in strategy_15 providing mean-reversion short confluence, with RiskEnforcer attaching the SHORT stop at entry + 2%.

KILL_ZONE_ENTRY.label: Kill Zone Entry
KILL_ZONE_ENTRY.thesis: Fired by Kill Zones (weight=16, SESSIONS) when price enters a high-liquidity window (London open 07:00 UTC, NY open 12:00 UTC, London close 16:00 UTC) with directional bias from upstream blocks; in strategy_08_killzone_fib this is the primary entry gate, with TIME_LIMIT cap at session close (TIME_LIMIT exit code) and RiskEnforcer sizing to MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 with STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

BULLISH_DOUBLE_TOP_BREAK.label: Bullish Double Top Break
BULLISH_DOUBLE_TOP_BREAK.thesis: Fired by Double Top (weight=30, PATTERNS — second-highest weight in corpus) when the second-top prints lower-than-first AND price breaks the neckline (note: this is the strategy_06 'failed double top' long signal), with RiskEnforcer sizing to MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the neckline.

BEARISH_DOUBLE_TOP.label: Bearish Double Top
BEARISH_DOUBLE_TOP.thesis: Fired by Double Top (weight=30, PATTERNS, direction=BEARISH) when price prints two highs within tolerance and the neckline breaks to the downside; in strategy_06 this is one of the three highest-conviction shorts (with IB Breakdown + Bearish BOS), gated by RiskEnforcer with SHORT stop at entry + 2% above the higher top.

WAVE_CONSOLIDATION_BREAK.label: Wave Consolidation Break
WAVE_CONSOLIDATION_BREAK.thesis: Fired by Wave Consolidation (weight=15, MARKET_STRUCTURE) when a contracting-range pattern (lower-highs + higher-lows) breaks in the direction of the prior trend; in strategy_06 this is the 12-point confluence trigger that pairs with IB Breakout + BOS + MACD for high-conviction breakouts, gated by RiskEnforcer with MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

BULLISH_BB_SQUEEZE_BREAK.label: Bullish Bollinger Squeeze Break
BULLISH_BB_SQUEEZE_BREAK.thesis: Fired by Bollinger Bands (weight=10, VOLATILITY) when the band-width contracts below 0.5% (BTC 15min tight threshold) and price breaks the upper band; in strategy_06 this is the 15-point confluence trigger for breakout direction, gated by RiskEnforcer with MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the squeeze low.

BEARISH_BB_SQUEEZE_BREAK.label: Bearish Bollinger Squeeze Break
BEARISH_BB_SQUEEZE_BREAK.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_BB_SQUEEZE_BREAK — fired when band-width contracts <0.5% and price breaks the lower band, with strategy_06 15-point weight and RiskEnforcer stop at entry + 2% above the squeeze high.

BULLISH_ORDER_BLOCK.label: Bullish Order Block
BULLISH_ORDER_BLOCK.thesis: Fired by Order Block detector (SMC_ICT) when price retests the last bearish candle before a bullish impulse and rejects with a 15min close above the OB high; in strategy_03_order_block this is the primary long trigger, gated by RiskEnforcer with STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the OB low.

BEARISH_ORDER_BLOCK.label: Bearish Order Block
BEARISH_ORDER_BLOCK.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_ORDER_BLOCK — fired when price retests the last bullish candle before a bearish impulse, in strategy_03 primary short trigger with RiskEnforcer stop at entry + 2% above the OB high.

BULLISH_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP.label: Bullish Liquidity Sweep
BULLISH_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP.thesis: Fired by Liquidity Sweep detector (SMC_ICT) when price sweeps below prior swing-low and reverses with a 15min close above; in strategy_02_liquidity_sweep this is the primary long trigger, gated by RiskEnforcer with MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the swept low.

BEARISH_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP.label: Bearish Liquidity Sweep
BEARISH_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP.thesis: Mirror of BULLISH_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP — fired when price sweeps above prior swing-high and reverses, in strategy_02 primary short trigger with RiskEnforcer stop at entry + 2% above the swept high.

EMA_PULLBACK_LONG.label: EMA Pullback Long
EMA_PULLBACK_LONG.thesis: Fired by EMA2050 Trend + VWAP confluence when price pulls back to the 20-EMA in an uptrend and reclaims with a 15min close above, with RSI not overbought (<70); in strategy_05_ema_pullback this is the primary long trigger, gated by RiskEnforcer with STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the EMA re-test candle low.

EMA_PULLBACK_SHORT.label: EMA Pullback Short
EMA_PULLBACK_SHORT.thesis: Mirror of EMA_PULLBACK_LONG — fired when price pulls back to the 50-EMA in a downtrend, in strategy_05 primary short trigger with RiskEnforcer stop at entry + 2% above the EMA re-test candle high.

WILLIAMS_FRACTAL_BREAK.label: Williams Fractal Break
WILLIAMS_FRACTAL_BREAK.thesis: Fired by Williams Fractal (TREND) when a 5-bar fractal high (or low for shorts) is broken by a 15min close, signaling structural continuation; in strategy_11_williams_fractal this is the primary trigger with confluence from BOS + VWAP, gated by RiskEnforcer with MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

ICT_SILVER_BULLET.label: ICT Silver Bullet
ICT_SILVER_BULLET.thesis: Fired by Silver Bullet (SMC_ICT) during the 10:00-11:00 AM EST kill-zone with FVG (Fair Value Gap) mitigation + BOS confirmation; in strategy_04_ict_silver_bullet this is the primary trigger, gated by RiskEnforcer with TIME_LIMIT exit at session close and STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

EUR_USD_BREAKOUT.label: EUR/USD Breakout
EUR_USD_BREAKOUT.thesis: Fired by IB Breakout (weight=30) on EUR/USD during London/NY overlap with volume confirmation; in strategy_07_eur_usd_breakout this is the primary trigger, sized to MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 with STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor.

BREAKOUT_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION.label: Breakout Pullback Continuation
BREAKOUT_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION.thesis: Fired when an IB Breakout is followed by a 15min pullback to the breakout level and a reclaim with BOS confirmation; in strategy_13_breakout_pullback this is the primary trigger with high win-rate, gated by RiskEnforcer with STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02 floor below the pullback low.

ERROR.label: Error — block internal fault
ERROR.thesis: Emitted by any block that encounters an internal exception or data-integrity failure (e.g. insufficient history, NaN propagation); registry.py line 231 exempts ERROR from signal_tiers requirement so the thick-client surfaces a visible fault instead of a silent miss, and the trade is recorded with status='closed' and partialBreakdown='ERROR' so the post-trade audit trail is preserved.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.label: Insufficient Data — block warm-up
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.thesis: Emitted by any block that has not yet accumulated the minimum required candle history (e.g. 200-period EMA needs 200 15min candles = ~50 hours); registry.py line 231 exempts INSUFFICIENT_DATA from signal_tiers requirement so the strategy can continue running while the warm-up completes, with no trade recorded (status remains empty).

NO_SIGNAL.label: No Signal — block idle
NO_SIGNAL.thesis: Emitted by any block when its detection criteria are not met on a given bar; the registry exempts NO_SIGNAL from signal_tiers requirement so the absence of a signal is correctly distinguished from a malformed signal, and no trade is opened (status remains empty, partialBreakdown is null).

MAX_POSITION_SIZE.label: Max Position Size = 1 (full-lot cap)
MAX_POSITION_SIZE.thesis: Hard cap on per-trade quantity enforced in src/strategies/risk_enforcer.py:MAX_POSITION_SIZE = Quantity.from_int(1); orders above this are rejected pre-trade so a single signal cannot concentrate risk beyond the institutional floor, regardless of confluence or strategy-level conviction.

MIN_POSITION_SIZE.label: Min Position Size = 0.001 (Binance lot-size floor)
MIN_POSITION_SIZE.thesis: Hard floor on per-trade quantity enforced in src/strategies/risk_enforcer.py:MIN_POSITION_SIZE = Quantity.from_str('0.001'); orders below this are rejected pre-trade so the residual from a TP3 runner cannot orphan below the exchange's minimum lot size, and exit code TIME_LIMIT or MAX_BARS cleanup leaves a tradeable residual.

DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT.label: Daily Loss Limit = $500 USD
DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT.thesis: Hard cap on cumulative realized PnL per UTC day enforced in src/strategies/risk_enforcer.py:DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT = Money('500.00', USD); when daily_pnl <= -DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT, all subsequent orders are rejected so a strategy in drawdown cannot compound losses beyond the institutional risk budget.

STOP_LOSS_PCT.label: Auto Stop Loss = 2% (RiskEnforcer floor)
STOP_LOSS_PCT.thesis: Hard cap on per-trade adverse excursion enforced in src/strategies/risk_enforcer.py:STOP_LOSS_PCT = 0.02; check_and_submit auto-attaches a stop_market at entry ± 2% as the institutional last-resort floor beneath every strategy-level structural SL (1.5×ATR or BOS swing), so a fat-finger or extreme gap cannot breach MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 or DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500.

MIN_RISK_REWARD_RATIO.label: Min Risk/Reward = 1.5 (TP1 must clear 1.5R)
MIN_RISK_REWARD_RATIO.thesis: Strategy-level guard requiring TP1 ≥ 1.5× the SL distance so the expected value of any signal is positive before size is allocated; in strategy_06 TP1 is 2R, in strategy_15 TP1 is VWAP reversion (typically 1.5–2R), so the threshold is structural rather than ticker-specific.

MAX_BARS_HELD.label: Max Bars Held = 50–200 (time-based thesis invalidation)
MAX_BARS_HELD.thesis: Strategy-level guard capping barsHeld at 50 (default) up to 200 (extended); positions exceeding the threshold are closed with exit code MAX_BARS on the premise that a thesis that hasn't reached TP within the structural horizon is invalidated by time decay, releasing capital for the next signal without breaching DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500.
MAX_BARS_HELD.appliesTo: all strategies with barsHeld exit path

DAILY_PNL_RESET.label: Daily PnL Reset (UTC midnight)
DAILY_PNL_RESET.thesis: DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT is reset at UTC midnight via RiskEnforcer.should_reset_daily_pnl() so the $500 risk budget is fresh each calendar day and the strategy can resume after a drawdown without carry-over compounding; reset is keyed on UTC yday (not local tz) so backtests and live execution share the same boundary.

TRAILING_STOP_LEVELS.label: Trailing Stop = L0..L3 (ATR-scaled)
TRAILING_STOP_LEVELS.thesis: Risk-management block (weight=8, RISK_MANAGEMENT) attaches a trailing stop at L0=0.8×ATR (tight), L1=1.2×ATR (standard), L2=1.6×ATR (balanced), or L3=2.0×ATR (wide) with atr_period=14, letting profitable positions run while protecting against reversal; the chosen level is set per-strategy (strategy_06 uses L2 balanced, strategy_15 uses L1 standard for mean reversion).
TRAILING_STOP_LEVELS.appliesTo: all strategies that attach a trailing stop post-entry

tp_allocation_universal.label: TP allocation = 50% / 30% / 20%
tp_allocation_universal.thesis: Universal scaled-exit pattern applied across the strategy corpus so partial profits are realized at three measured-move targets without exposing the full position to reversal; TP1=50% locks the floor, TP2=30% captures the measured move, TP3=20% runs the structural target, with all residual sized to MIN_POSITION_SIZE=0.001 to remain executable.

stop_distance_universal.label: SL distance = 1.5×ATR beyond entry
stop_distance_universal.thesis: Universal stop pattern at 1.5×ATR(14) beyond entry so the SL is volatility-normalized and adapts to the current regime, with RiskEnforcer auto-attaching the ±2% (STOP_LOSS_PCT=0.02) floor beneath so a low-volatility regime cannot produce an absurdly tight structural SL.

risk_per_trade.label: Risk per trade = 1% of equity (default)
risk_per_trade.thesis: Default risk budget per trade is 1% of account equity so a 5-loss streak does not breach the institutional drawdown tolerance; sized against the SL distance (1.5×ATR) and capped by MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 so the per-trade USD risk is volatility-normalized AND quantity-capped.

min_confluence_threshold.label: Min confluence = 55–60 (strategy-dependent)
min_confluence_threshold.thesis: Strategy-level guard requiring the sum of block weights for firing signals to exceed a threshold (strategy_15_bollinger_mean_reversion: 55, strategy_06_range_breakout: 60) so a single block firing alone does not allocate risk; the threshold is set per-strategy based on the block-weight distribution.

leverage_cap.label: Leverage cap = 5× (configurable per strategy)
leverage_cap.thesis: Max leverage configurable per strategy (default 5× in BacktestConfigFull.maxLeverage) so position size can be amplified without breaching MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 (which caps absolute quantity, not notional); backtests enforce the cap so results are reproducible, live execution respects MAX_POSITION_SIZE=1 and DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT=$500 floor.

confluence_scoring.label: Confluence scoring = REQUIRED vs OPTIONAL block logic
confluence_scoring.thesis: Each block's weight is classified as REQUIRED (must fire) or OPTIONAL (confluence boost) by the validator, so a single REQUIRED block failing invalidates the signal even when OPTIONAL blocks align; this is the institutional risk-desk discipline that prevents one-block-fits-all strategies from being gamed by feeding synthetic data.

RSI.label: Relative Strength Index (14-period)
RSI.thesis: Momentum oscillator bounded 0–100 used as oversold/overbought filter; BTC 15min zones are extreme_oversold<20, oversold<30, neutral_low<40, neutral_high<60, overbought>70, extreme_overbought>80 (from src/indicators/rsi_zones.py); primary trigger for RSI Divergence (weight=25, OSCILLATORS — highest in the corpus) and secondary filter for EMA Pullback + VWAP Reclaim strategies.

MACD.label: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (12/26/9)
MACD.thesis: Trend-following momentum indicator with MACD line, signal line (9-period EMA of MACD), and histogram; BTC 15min strength thresholds are weak<50, moderate 50-150, strong 150-300 (from src/indicators/macd_strength.py); cross-confirmed breakouts above the strong threshold gate strategy_06 entries at the 22-point weight, with EXIT_009-aware histogram slope preventing late-entry whipsaws.

BollingerBands.label: Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2σ)
BollingerBands.thesis: Volatility envelope with upper/lower bands at ±2σ of 20-period SMA; BTC 15min squeeze thresholds are tight<0.5%, normal<1.5%, wide<3.0% (from src/indicators/bollinger_squeeze.py); primary trigger for mean-reversion (strategy_15) and squeeze-breakout (strategy_06) entries with weight=10/15 respectively.

StochasticRSI.label: Stochastic RSI (14, 14, 3, 3)
StochasticRSI.thesis: Momentum oscillator applied to RSI (not price) with %K and %D lines bounded 0–100; oversold<20 and overbought>80 zones; tertiary trigger for mean-reversion entries in strategy_15 with weight=18, paired with RSI Divergence (weight=25) and Bollinger Bands (weight=15) for the 55-point confluence threshold.

VWAP.label: Volume-Weighted Average Price (session)
VWAP.thesis: Session-anchored volume-weighted average price used as institutional fair value; reclaim from below triggers BULLISH_VWAP_RECLAIM, rejection from above triggers BEARISH_VWAP_REJECTION, both at weight=15 in INSTITUTIONAL category (priority=3 in registry); primary target for mean-reversion TP1 in strategy_15 (50% allocation).

EMA_20_50.label: Exponential Moving Average 20 / 50
EMA_20_50.thesis: Trend-filter EMAs with the 20-EMA as fast leg and 50-EMA as slow leg; bullish alignment (20 > 50) and price above 20-EMA gates EMA_PULLBACK_LONG, bearish alignment gates EMA_PULLBACK_SHORT, both at combined weight=55 in TREND category; required input for strategy_05_ema_pullback and confluence input for strategy_15 mean reversion.

ATR.label: Average True Range (14-period)
ATR.thesis: Volatility indicator used to normalize SL distance (1.5×ATR) and trailing-stop levels (L0=0.8× to L3=2.0×ATR); ATR-period=14 is the universal window so backtest and live execution share the same volatility basis; rises in ATR trigger SL widening (structural tolerance) and falls trigger SL tightening (regime-shift awareness).

ADX.label: Average Directional Index (14-period)
ADX.thesis: Trend-strength filter with ADX>25 confirming a trending regime so the trend-following strategies (strategy_06, strategy_05) do not fire in a ranging market where breakouts fail; confluence filter, not a primary trigger, used by strategy_06 to gate the IB Breakout signal and by strategy_05 to gate the EMA Pullback signal.

OBV.label: On-Balance Volume
OBV.thesis: Cumulative volume indicator confirming directional volume pressure; rising OBV on a bullish breakout confirms accumulation, falling OBV on a bearish breakout confirms distribution; used by strategy_06 as a secondary confluence filter with weight=8 (low) but high institutional credibility.

WilliamsFractal.label: Williams Fractal (5-bar)
WilliamsFractal.thesis: 5-bar swing-point indicator marking local highs (two higher highs on each side) and local lows (two lower lows on each side); break of the most recent fractal high/low fires WILLIAMS_FRACTAL_BREAK at weight=18 in TREND category; primary trigger for strategy_11_williams_fractal.

KillZone.label: Kill Zone (session window)
KillZone.thesis: Time-of-day indicator marking high-liquidity windows (London 07:00-16:00 UTC, NY 12:00-17:00 UTC, Asia 00:00-08:00 UTC); primary gate for strategy_08_killzone_fib (weight=16, SESSIONS) and strategy_04_ict_silver_bullet; closes the position at session boundary via exit code TIME_LIMIT.
